verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents centralized AI Provider credential management. AI Model Provider entities hold the provider credentials, and they can reference secrets from external backends via AI Vault (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, environment variables). It also supports Azure Managed Identity for provider auth, so operators supply their own provider credentials and the gateway uses them to proxy traffic, for example to Anthropic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-developer or per-request client-supplied key passthrough, concrete configuration examples showing the API key field, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
